offers_products.reason: Main offering is regulated electric and natural gas delivery service, not goods or software.

offers_services.reason: Regulated electric and natural gas utility service in Washington, Idaho and Oregon.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Residential households are main electricity and natural gas customers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Commercial and industrial customers also buy electricity and gas; wholesale sales to utilities too.

recurring_revenue.reason: Customers pay monthly for ongoing electric and gas utility service.

cyclical_demand.reason: Electricity and heating gas are essential; customers cannot easily postpone them in a downturn.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the generation, transmission and distribution network, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customer base is mostly households and small-to-mid commercial customers.

asset_heavy.reason: Utility needs continuous capital investment in hydro and thermal plants, power lines and gas distribution.
